name: playpint
description: Playpint monorepo for local group games.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test "dist/**/*.test.js"
scripts.validate: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test "dist/**/*.test.js"
